name: One primary action per view
rule: Give each view a single dominant action; every other action is visibly quieter, so the next step is obvious.

leaders.note: Allows one primary button per page to mark the main call to action. Header, modal and side-panel buttons are not counted. Content-only pages may use no primary button.
Keeps actions in a consistent header spot. On detail views the primary action comes first, and a full-page app gets one page-wide primary action.
The default button style is the primary action, such as save or deploy. A secondary style sits beside it for supporting actions, and a separate error style is for destructive confirmations.
